name: screens-team-invite
title: Invite your team
description: Invite your team. Blocks/Wizard pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/blocks/Screens and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in block built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system.
